# Adversarial commands the floor (crates/approval/src/floor.rs) leaves to the
# local classifier: each runs a program from the checkout, or a tool the
# floor does not know, the same way `cargo test` or `make` does. A model
# "safe" runs them; the sandbox keeps them out of .git and the secret paths,
# but not off the network. `floor_holds_everything_else` fails when a
# dangerous or adversarial command outside this list gets past the floor, so
# a line is added here only as a reviewed decision.
